newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey plans dollar-indexed public salaries.
newsitem.headline: Turkey plans dollar-indexed public salaries.

text.p: Turkey's Islamist-led coalition government is planning to index public sector pay rises to the dollar, officials said on Wednesday.

Salaries would be fixed in dollar terms and paid in Turkish lira based on the appreciation of the dollar against the lira, Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan said late on Tuesday after an economic council meeting.
The dollar's appreciation tracks inflation in Turkey as part of the country's monetary policies.
The dollar has gained 53.5 percent against the lira in the first nine months of 1996, compared to a nine-month wholesale inflation rate of 60.5 percent.
